records.subject: Your Wrenfield subscription has been canceled
records.body:
Hi Isla,

This confirms the cancellation of your Wrenfield plan. Sorry to see Silver Collective go -- if there's feedback on what didn't work, I'd genuinely like to hear it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:

Wanted to check if timing was the issue -- if now's better than when you signed up, happy to do a quick setup call.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Noticed you invited someone to the team. Hope the handoff's been smooth -- anything I can help with?

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Collective!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no first project and no key milestone; admin never replied to two outreach emails (email:72f202a4, email:4b7d83ca) and no-showed the kickoff (calendar:dfcbd246). One invite sent shows some intent, but zero engagement with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Silver Collective's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Sorry we missed each other at the kickoff last week — easy to let that slip in a busy stretch. I can see an invite has gone out to a teammate, which is a good start.

The next step is getting a first project set up, since projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get the first one set up around real work your team already has in flight.

Just reply with a day that suits.

Best,
Chidi
